title: Aromatic Light Slovakian Sun Dried Tomato Tagine
description: A nutty and light Slovakian dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes, served in a ceramic tagine, perfect for a solo dinner, this recipe is also buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not include any animal products.

ingredients.name: sun dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the chopped sun dried tomatoes, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Place the skillet mixture onto one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the puff pastry over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the tagine in a ceramic dish and add the water to the dish.
Cover the dish with a lid or foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
